description: Use this when someone asks whether Venus is retrograde now, when Venus retrograde starts or ends, or for the Venus retrograde dates of a year ("is Venus retrograde", "Venus retrograde 2026", "when does Venus go direct", "Venus retrograde in Libra"). Returns the period running now or the next one, with its shadow dates, its signs in both zodiacs, the day Venus meets the Sun, and the ones after it. Venus turns retrograde about every 19 months, for about six weeks. Needs no birth details and no place. Say it without fear: it is a stretch of the calendar, not a warning.

year.description: Optional: list every Venus retrograde touching this year.
